common.comingSoonBody: This screen is part of the {module} module, scheduled for phase {phase} of the roadmap. Your role already has access to it.

login.title: Sign in
login.demoHint: Demo mode: click a user to sign in with their role.

dashboard.subtitle: Figures for your role, then the operational counters of each department you work in.
dashboard.unitsHint: Orders invoiced; the sale counts on its invoice date.
dashboard.grossMarginHint: From the journal: revenue (70) less cost of sales (60), as in the P&L report.
dashboard.productivityHint: Month to date. Productivity = clocked ÷ available; efficiency = billed ÷ clocked.
dashboard.partsTurnoverHint: Parts used at cost over the last {days} days, annualised, over the stock held.

vehicle.title: Vehicles
vehicle.statusFollowsFlow: The status follows the sales flow: arrival, reconditioning, reservation, invoice, delivery. It is never changed by hand.
vehicle.stockCarLocked: The site, brand, owner, price and VAT regime of a stock car change through sales.
vehicle.stockEntersThroughSales: Cars for sale are not created here: they enter stock through sales.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.invalid_transition: This status change is not allowed.

accounting.label: Label
accounting.noOpenItems: No open invoices for this customer.
accounting.selectPeriod: Select a period to see its checklist.
accounting.closePackHint: Review these reports for the period before locking it.

sales.pipelineHint: Every open deal from first contact to delivery
sales.newLeadHint: Someone is interested in a car: record who, where and what they need.
sales.stockVehicle: Vehicle in stock or on order
sales.reservedWarning: Reserved for {name}: the quote can be sent, but the car cannot be sold to this customer while the reservation runs.
sales.versionFacts: {fuel} · {co2} g/km CO₂ · {hp} hp · delivered in about {days} days
sales.applyIncentive: Pass on the manufacturer incentive ({amount} excl. VAT)
sales.customerTradesIn: The customer trades in a car
sales.overAllowanceHint: The offer is {amount} above the car's value net of repairs: this over-allowance counts as discount.
sales.financeBalanceHint: Finance everything the customer still owes
sales.financingHint: The lender pays the dealer {pct} of the amount financed. Duration {min} to {max} months; APR defaults to the lender's standard rate.
sales.chooseVehicleToPrice: Choose a vehicle to price the deal.
sales.financingFacts: APR {apr} · cost of credit {cost} · purchase option {residual}
sales.approvalNeeded: This discount needs the approval of a {role} before the quote goes to the customer.
sales.reviseConfirm: Put this quote back to draft to change it?
sales.declineConfirm: Close this quote as declined by the customer?
sales.acceptConfirm: The customer accepts: create the order form? A trade-in is taken into used stock now.
sales.approvalRequest: Effective discount {discount}: needs a {role}. Requested by {by} on {date}.
sales.waitingForApprover: Waiting for an approver: you cannot approve your own request.
sales.label: Label
sales.ordersHint: Signed order forms, from deposit to delivery
sales.invoiceConfirm: Issue the customer invoice ({total})? The vehicle leaves stock and the entries are posted.
sales.registrationPlaceholder: Leave empty to register a new plate
sales.cancelOrderHint: Releases the vehicle, hands the trade-in back and reverses its purchase. Refund any deposit from accounting.
sales.vnStockHint: On order, in transit and in stock
sales.orderForStockHint: Order a vehicle from the manufacturer without a customer.
sales.stockOrderFacts: Dealer cost {cost} · delivered in about {days} days
sales.noSiteSellsBrand: None of your sites sells this brand.
sales.receiveHint: Enter the manufacturer's invoice amount excl. VAT: the purchase is booked and the car enters stock at this value.
sales.buyUsedCarHint: From a private seller (VAT on margin) or a trader. The car enters stock in intake.
sales.resaleRegimeHint: Margin unless a trader invoiced VAT
sales.policeRegisterHint: Mandatory register of used vehicles bought and sold
sales.catalogueHint: Manufacturer price list (fictional prices) and add-on products

market.basisCatalogue: New price {price} (catalogue), {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} old. Market feed: fictional values.
market.basisFallback: Model not in the catalogue: new price taken as {price}, {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} old. Market feed: fictional values.
market.title: Market price
market.voHint: Fill in the make, model, first registration, mileage and fuel above, then ask the feed: its trade value can become the purchase price.

oem.title: Manufacturer portal
oem.subtitle: Mock of the manufacturer's order portal: where each factory order is in the plant, its promised date and the invoice to come. The manufacturer ships built cars and may push dates back.
oem.shipped: Shipped: the car is in transit

parts.catalogueHint: References, prices, suppliers and supersessions, with stock across the group.
parts.activeHint: Inactive parts cannot be ordered or sold.
parts.familyHint: Product family, e.g. BRAKES, FILTERS, OILS.
parts.partNumberFixed: The part number cannot be changed once created.
parts.effectiveOnHint: From this date the old number sells and reorders as the new one.
parts.removeSupersessionConfirm: Remove this supersession? The old number becomes orderable again.
parts.priceClassHint: Sets the discount applied to each line from the part's discount code.
parts.discountMatrixHint: Discount off the retail price for each discount code and price class.
parts.levelsHint: Bin and reorder levels per site. Replenishment orders up to max when available stock falls below min.
parts.movementsHint: Every receipt, sale, transfer and adjustment, with the PMP after each one.
parts.obsoleteHint: {count} items with no movement for {months} months (since {date}), worth {value}.
parts.transfersHint: Stock moved between sites at PMP, through the site liaison account.
parts.newTransferHint: Moves stock at the source site's PMP. Each site posts its side through 181000.
parts.purchasingHint: Stock and emergency orders to suppliers, receipts and backorders.
parts.suggestionsHint: Items below min at {site}, ordered up to max net of what is already on order.
parts.noSuggestions: Nothing to reorder: every item is at or above its minimum.
parts.createAllOrders: {count, plural, one {Create the order} other {Create # orders}}
parts.createOrdersConfirm: Create {count, plural, one {a draft order} other {# draft orders}} worth {value}?
parts.newOrderHint: A draft order to one supplier. Add lines, then send it.
parts.kindHint: Emergency orders are delivered next day.
parts.expectedOnHint: Leave empty to use the supplier lead time.
parts.closeOrderConfirm: Close the order? Lines still expected are cancelled as backorders.
parts.receiveHint: Enter what arrived. Stock and PMP update now; the value goes to goods received not invoiced until the supplier's invoice.
parts.supplierInvoicesHint: Invoices matched to goods receipts; variances above tolerance need approval.
parts.newSupplierInvoiceHint: Pick the site and supplier, then tick the receipt lines the invoice bills at the supplier's prices.
parts.nothingToBill: No receipt from this supplier is waiting for an invoice.
parts.varianceExplain: The invoice differs from the receipts by {variance}, above the tolerance of {tolerance} or {percent} %. Approve it to post the difference to purchases, or reject it.
parts.awaitingApproval: Waiting for a parts manager to approve the variance.
parts.counterHint: Quotes and sales to retail and trade customers, invoiced at the counter.
parts.newCounterSaleHint: Start a quote for a customer; add parts, then confirm to reserve them.
parts.cancelSaleConfirm: Cancel this sale? Reserved stock is released.
parts.shortStock: Some lines exceed the available stock: receive or transfer stock before invoicing.
parts.invoiceSaleHint: Issues the invoice, takes the parts out of stock at PMP and records the payment if paid now.
parts.inventoryHint: Count a slice of the stock; variances are posted to stock variation at PMP.
parts.newCountHint: Picks the items to count by family or bin, least recently counted first.
parts.label: Label
parts.binPrefixHint: Only bins starting with this, e.g. A1.
parts.cancelCountConfirm: Cancel this count? Nothing is posted.
parts.countSheetHint: Enter the quantity found in each bin. Leave a line empty if it was not counted.
parts.postAfterSave: Post the count after saving (adjusts stock and posts the variance)

workshop.bookHint: Find the customer's car, then pick a technician, a day and a time.
workshop.cancelRoConfirm: Cancel this repair order? Issued parts go back to stock.
workshop.checkInHint: Check in a booked car, a walk-in, or a used car from stock for reconditioning.
workshop.clockingHint: Technicians clock on and off jobs; clocked time is compared with the standard time billed.
workshop.damagesHint: One per line, as ZONE: note. Zones: {zones}.
workshop.insurerHint: Only for jobs paid by an insurer
workshop.internalHint: Work on a used car in stock, charged at the internal rate and added to the car's stock value.
workshop.invoiceRoHint: One invoice per payer: the customer, each insurer, the manufacturer for each warranty job. Internal work is added to the used car's value.
workshop.isAdditional: Additional work: needs the customer's approval
workshop.kpiHint: Productivity = clocked ÷ available hours. Efficiency = billed standard hours ÷ clocked hours. Utilisation = billed ÷ available. Billed hours count invoiced repair orders.
workshop.labourCatalogueHint: Standard times per operation, billed at the payer's hourly rate.
workshop.noJobs: No job yet: add the work to do below.
workshop.noOwnerHint: This car has no known owner: record the owner on the vehicle first.
workshop.plannerHint: Appointments by technician and day; bars show booked hours against capacity.
workshop.rejectConfirm: Reject this claim? Its invoice to the manufacturer will be credited.
workshop.remittanceHint: Tick the claims the manufacturer paid; one receipt settles their invoices on the OEM account.
workshop.repairOrdersHint: From check-in to hand-over: jobs, parts, clocking, quality check and invoicing per payer.
workshop.signatureHint: The customer signs to accept the check-in record.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Financial statements and reconciliations, computed from the journal.
reports.pnlHint: Revenue, cost of sales, gross margin and result per department.
reports.vatHint: Collected and deductible VAT for a month, with sales by rate.
reports.receivablesHint: What customers owe, by days past due.
reports.payablesHint: What we owe suppliers, by days past due.
reports.stockValueHint: VN, VO and parts sub-ledgers reconciled with 371, 372 and 373.
reports.trialBalanceHint: Balances of every account over a period.
reports.fecHint: Every journal line of a fiscal year in the French standard layout (pipe-separated).
reports.fecGroupOnly: The FEC covers the whole legal entity: it is available to group-wide users only.
reports.workshopNote: Workshop labour cost sits in salaries (operating expenses), so its gross margin is before payroll.
reports.salesByRate: Sales by regime and rate (invoices and credit notes issued)
reports.ageingHint: Unapplied = money received or paid but not yet matched to a document; balance = the account balance.
reports.payablesMethod: Supplier documents are not dated for payment, so the balance is matched to the most recent documents (FIFO) and falls due after the supplier's terms.
reports.closePackHint: Reports for this month before locking it.

pdf.noVatShown: VAT not shown on these lines (VAT on the margin or outside the scope of VAT).

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.subtitle: Moves the business clock forward day by day. Each site's staff act through the same services as the screens: leads, quotes, orders, deliveries, workshop visits, parts, payments.
simulation.ratesHint: Per site and per open day (Monday–Saturday) unless stated; shares between 0 and 1.
simulation.refusedSteps: Steps refused by the business rules
simulation.cli: Also from a terminal, with a flag per rate:

rate.vnShare: Share of leads for a new car
rate.supplierVarianceRate: Supplier invoices with a price difference

ui.settingsHint: Read-only. Values come from the seed and drive the business rules.
ui.name: Name
ui.rolesHint: Module × action. Roles are granted per site or on all sites (Admin → Users).
ui.demoPassword: Demo password for every seeded user: demo1234
